$description: Layout and tools: menubar, toolbar and floating action bar, resizable panels, stepper, page header, settings layout and filter bar. DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (approved on the review board, F-D072 to F-D075), first shown in round 8, 13 Oct 2026. Component files: menubar.css + menubar.js, toolbar.css + toolbar.js, resizable.css + resizable.js, stepper.css, page-header.css, settings.css + settings.js, filter-bar.css + filter-bar.js. Sizes and the few surface steps these need; every colour points at an existing role, no new colours. Built into --ui-<group>-<key> by node tools/tokens/build.mjs.

trigger.description: A menu name in the bar (Campaign, Creative, View, Help): a 36 px quiet pill, 44 to touch. Open, it sits on the quiet hover surface in Ink.

gap.description: Between the menu names (4 px): they read as one bar, without a container or a line under it.

content-width.description: Least width of a menubar menu (glass, radius float): room for an icon, the words and a shortcut in keys at the end.

sub-gap.description: A submenu (Export as) opens 8 px beside its menu, so the two glasses read as two layers; its first row level with the row that opened it.

indicator.description: The leading slot of a menubar row (16 px): the icon, or the check of a checkbox row, or the dot of a radio row, so every label in a menu starts on one line.

radio-dot.description: The dot of the chosen radio row (6 px, Porcelain on the glass). A checkbox row shows the check; neither is ever Amber.

tray.description: The tray the editor tools sit in: one step toward Ink on Porcelain, a pill with 6 px around the 40 px circles, so the tools read as one object without a stroke.

group-gap.description: Between groups of tools (12 px), three times the 4 px inside a group: the separator is space, never a line.

readout.description: The zoom readout (100 %) between zoom out and zoom in, in the data face; a fixed width, so the buttons never move when the number changes.

bar-bottom.description: The floating action bar sits 24 px above the bottom of the screen, plus the phone's safe area (env(safe-area-inset-bottom)).

bar-margin.description: Least room beside the floating action bar on a narrow screen (8 px, like the drawer), so the glass pill never touches the screen's edge.

bar-z.description: Stacking of the floating action bar and the settings save bar: over the page, under dialogs and drawers (50), so a confirm dialog's scrim covers the bar it came from.

gap.description: The handle between two panels is this space (12 px), not a line. Its hit area is 44 px wide all the same.

grip-thickness.description: The grip: a small pill in the middle of the gap, 4 px across.

grip-length.description: The grip's length at hover and focus.

grip-length-active.description: The grip's length while dragging: it stretches, so the hand feels it took hold.

grip-touch.description: The grip at rest where there is no hover (touch screens): always faintly there, one step above the layer behind. With a mouse it is hidden until hover or focus.

grip-hover.description: The grip under the pointer or with keyboard focus (focus also draws the Ink ring around it).

grip-active.description: The grip while dragging: Ink, the colour that decides.

step.description: Percent a panel grows or shrinks per arrow key (Shift: twice that); Home and End go to the panel's least and most size.

marker.description: The step marker: a 24 px circle with the step number, the size of the selected creative's badge.

marker-gap.description: From the marker to its label (12 px); label to its description 4.

step-gap.description: Between steps side by side (24 px, twice the 12 from a marker to its words). Steps are told apart by space and their numbers; there is no connector line.

row-gap.description: Between steps stacked upright (24 px), twice the air inside a step.

marker-done.description: A finished step: the Ink check on the sunken circle. Never Amber: Amber is only the Quality Gate check on a checked creative.

marker-upcoming.description: A step still to come: its number in tertiary on the quietest circle, so the eye goes to the current step in Ink.

dot.description: The compact stepper on a phone (Step 2 of 5): one 6 px dot per step, Ink when done, sunken when still to come.

dot-current.description: The current step in the compact stepper: the dot stretched to a 20 px pill in Ink.

crumb-gap.description: From the breadcrumb to the title (12 px).

meta-gap.description: From the title to its quiet meta line in the data face (8 px): they belong together.

heading-min.description: The title keeps at least this much of its line before the actions wrap under it; below it they move to the next line instead of crushing the title.

meta-separator.description: The room each quiet dot takes between parts of the meta line (16 px, the dot centred). A dot that would start a line is clipped away.

tabs-gap.description: From the header to its tabs (24 px), three times the title-to-meta gap.

actions-gap.description: Between the header's actions (8 px). The primary action is the one Ink button, last in the row.

page-max.description: The widest a settings page runs beside its navigation, so a form keeps a calm measure.

gap.description: Between the settings navigation and its page (32 px).

section-gap.description: Between sections of a settings page (48 px), twice the 24 px between fields: sections are parted by space, never a line.

savebar-bottom.description: The save bar floats 16 px above the bottom of the page (plus the safe area) once something has changed.

search-min.description: The search's starting width in the row: chips and sort take their room first, then the search grows up to its full width; only when even this does not fit does the row wrap.

search.description: The search field in a wide filter bar; on a phone it takes the whole row.

sort.description: The sort select at the end of a wide filter bar (a field, radius 12, its listbox glass). On a phone sorting moves into the filter sheet.

menu.description: Least width of a filter chip's glass menu: room for the option, its data hint and the check.

gap.description: Between the controls of the filter bar (8 px).

row-gap.description: From the controls to the row of active filters and the result count (12 px).

results-gap.description: From the filter bar to the creatives it filters (24 px), twice the gap inside the bar.

pill.description: An active filter (Status: Waiting for Anna): a 32 px pill with its remove circle, 44 to touch.

pill-bg.description: An active filter pill: the sunken surface, the key in tertiary and the value in Ink. No stroke.

pill-bg-hover.description: The remove circle in a filter pill under the pointer, and pressed.

remove.description: The remove circle (x) at the end of a filter pill; its hit area is 44.
